verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੈ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਛਬਿ ਤਿਲ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharasan jot ko udhot sukh saagar mai koTik usatat chhab til ko pragaas hai ||

en.bdb: The radiance of the light of the True Guru, the ocean of happiness and comfort is repository of all the happiness of the world. A glimmer of light no more than a sesame seed has generated radiance of millions of beauties and adulations in the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਕਮਲਾ ਕਲਪਤਰੁ ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਮਧੁ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ki(n)chat kirapaa koTik kamalaa kalapatar madhur bachan madh koTik bilaas hai ||

en.bdb: A little kind look of the True Guru has millions of goddesses of wealth and celestial trees capable of fulfilling all desires, hidden in it. Elixir immersed sweet words of the True Guru has millions of relishments of the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੰਦ ਮੁਸਕਾਨਿ ਬਾਨਿ ਖਾਨਿ ਹੈ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸਸਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ ਕੁਮਦਨੀ ਤਾਸੁ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ma(n)dh musakaan baan khaan hai koTaan sas sobhaa koT loT poT kumadhanee taas hai ||

en.bdb: The habit of soft and slow smile of the True Guru is the source of praise of millions of moons. The glory of millions of nymphea flowers is sacrifice unto it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਿਵ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਸ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੪॥
verses.translit_en: man madhukar makara(n)dh ras lubhit hui sahaj samaadh liv bisam bisavais hai ||294||

en.bdb: A devoted and loving Sikh of the Guru enamoured by the elixir-like relishment of Naam Simran practiced through the teachings of the True Guru remains absorbed in a state of equipoise and astonishing devotion of the Lord. (294)
